meta.name: cyber-ir-playbook
meta.description: Build incident response timelines and report packs from event logs. Use for detection-to-recovery reporting, phase tracking, and stakeholder-ready incident summaries.

copy.tagline: 从事件日志生成应急响应时间线和报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责安全事件调查与复盘报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate incident response timelines and reports from event logs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle security incident investigation and post-mortem reporting

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据事件日志生成标准化的应急响应时间线和分阶段报告，涵盖检测、遏制、清除、恢复和事后总结。
howto.when: 当你提供带有时间戳的安全事件日志，并要求进行应急响应分析或生成报告时触发。

say.text: 根据这些日志生成应急响应时间线。
say.note: Claude 会按阶段整理事件顺序。

say.text: 帮我生成一份面向管理层的应急响应报告。
say.note: Claude 会输出分阶段总结报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a standardized incident response timeline and phase-based report from event logs, covering detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident phases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide timestamped security event logs and request incident response analysis or report generation.

say_en.text: Generate an incident response timeline from these logs.
say_en.note: Claude will order events by phase.

say_en.text: Create an executive incident response report.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a phase-summary report.
